best_idea: A trade settles only when both sides accept, any offer change resets both accepts, and the server cancels rather than half-completing when a lore, NoDrop or capacity check fails.
decision_why: Keep the accept-reset gate and the lore and NoDrop cancel gates; reject the per-item partial settle, because a player must never receive less than the confirmed offer without seeing it; fix the coin check order (destination checked before the debit).
acceptance: Two test players: A offers a lore item that B already holds; both accept; the trade is cancelled with no item moved and both accepts clear. B's bag is full and both accept: cancelled, no coin moves. A coin offer of -5 is refused at write; an offer above A's balance is clamped to the balance and shown before confirm.
